title: Goodwill vouchers
body:
Support hands out goodwill vouchers when something goes wrong.

Add a new module `parcelo/vouchers.py` with `issue_voucher(customer_id, amount)`. It creates a `Voucher` with an id, the customer id, the amount and `issued_at`, saves it in a new `vouchers` collection on the store, and returns it. Define the `Voucher` dataclass in `parcelo/models.py` (fields `id`, `customer_id`, `amount`, `issued_at`) and add the `vouchers` collection to `parcelo/store.py` (cleared in `reset()` like the others).

A single voucher cannot be worth more than 150.00. Issuing one for a customer that does not exist, for more than that, or for an amount that is zero or negative must fail.
